feeds.title: Cineuropa
feeds.description: Cineuropa is the press agency for European cinema. News, interviews, film database, industry reports and more, published and updated daily in English, French, Spanish and Italian

feeds.title: Film New Europe
feeds.description: FILM NEW EUROPE is a free on-line daily information service that provides continually updated news about the film and TV industries in the 12 new European Union states plus Turkey. FNE is the only such resource based in Central Europe and is owned and run by and for the filmmakers themselves. Its mission is to forge ties among the film professionals in Europes fastest-growing economies and with the other members of the EU as well as reaching international markets with relevant information.

feeds.title: Screen Daily
feeds.description: The online home of Screen International, posting breaking film news, the latest film reviews and reports from film festivals and film awards around the world.

feeds.title: The People's Movies
feeds.description: An exciting new addition to the film ranking is The People's Movies, which was created by a movie fan to share their love of film and rediscover (and uncover) the greats. Founded by Paul Devine and kept up to date by a team of freelance writers, the blog focuses on films, TV, anime and wrestling. The People's Movies brings to light articles, news and reviews on a variety of different series, films and wrestling highlights.

feeds.title: Europa Cinemas Blog
feeds.description: Europa Cinemas is the first network of cinemas focusing on European films. Created in 1992 at the initiative of a group of thirty cinema exhibitors, it has become in 25 years a network uniting more than 1,100 cinemas (nearly 3,000 screens) in 43 countries.

feeds.title: The Film Experience Blog
feeds.description: Follow this blog for the passionate daily cinematic observations. 'Awards, Actresses, Cinematic Musings...' that's what they serve up with a little something from all cinematic eras / genres and occasional forays theater and television.

feeds.title: UK Film Review Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2012, this is an entertainment website dedicated to film reviews, movie trailers, film festivals, and indie film making. One of the most popular providers of short film reviews in the UK. Movies are their passion and they want to discuss the best and worst in the film industry.

feeds.title: Movie Curiosities - The online diary of an aspiring movie nerd
feeds.description: A blog about movie reviews and literature. FMUK is a non-profit community sharing showfilmfirst codes for free advance previews nationwide.

feeds.title: Battleroyalewithcheese(BRWC)
feeds.description: Created by Alton Williams, battleroyalewithcheese (also known as BRWC) was launched in 2008 as 'a bit of fun' and has now blossomed into one of the leading film blogs, boasting a talented team of contributors. BRWC brings together those with a love of film, and presents a collection of film and video game reviews, exclusive interviews, news, features and detailed commentary.

feeds.title: East European Film Bulletin
feeds.description: A monthly online journalistic and literary project dedicated to the criticism of films related to Eastern Europe.

feeds.title: European Children's Film Association
feeds.description: ECFA is the organisation for all, who are interested in high quality films for children and young people: film makers, producers, promotors, distributors, exhibitors, TV-programmers, festival organizers and film educators.

feeds.title: Flatpack Films Blog
feeds.description: Follow this blog to stay up to date in the topics related to the Hungarian film industry, film production in Hungary, and filming in Hungary. Flatpackfilms is a Budapest-based film company offering an inspiring and creative work atmosphere for its host of clients from around the world.

feeds.title: The Spoilist
feeds.description: The Spoilist is a film and TV reviews and features site.

feeds.title: Film Archives UK
feeds.description: Film Archives UK (FAUK) brings together archives, archivists, associate organisations and individuals who are interested in and committed to the work and development of the UK's public sector film archives.

feeds.title: Rooftop Film Club Blog
feeds.description: Rooftop Film Club Blog is all about the news, reviews and rooftop film club.

feeds.title: MPA EMEA - Motion Picture Association Blog
feeds.description: The voice and advocate of the major international producers and distributors of movies, home entertainment and television programming in Europe.

feeds.title: The Bearded Trio
feeds.description: All the latest news on John Williams, Steven Spielberg and George Lucas. A bunch of bloggers bringing you the latest news on the movie directors and composer. We will post unbiased movie reviews and the latest news and blog posts on Lucasfilm, Star Wars and more.

feeds.title: East German Cinema Blog
feeds.description: A blog devoted to the films of the GDR. Every week or two (or sometimes three) Jim Mortons examines a new film, giving as much information as he can without spoiling the plot. Most posts also include historical information as well as biographies of actors, directors, composers, and cinematographers.

feeds.title: Movie Barf
feeds.description: Movie Barf is a disgustingly lovely blog about one man's obsession with all things film. Prague based movie reviews, articles and other trash.

feeds.title: Soleil Film GmbH Blog
feeds.description: Soleil Film GmbH Blog shares news from Austrian film production. Soleil Film was founded in October 2008 as a company from a creative collective for film production. The founding members are Jürgen Karasek, Filip Antoni Malinowski and Alice Karasek. Our goal is the production of artistically demanding and socially critical documentaries and feature films that are a sustainable contribution to the social discourse.

feeds.title: Experimental Cinema - News and resources on experimental films
feeds.description: Experimental Cinema is an independent website dedicated to provide information and promote experimental & avant-garde film.

feeds.title: Festival de Cannes - Cannes Film Festival
feeds.description: Cannes Film Festival, is an annual film festival held in Cannes, France, which previews new films of all genres, including documentaries from all around the world. The institutional site provides access to 70 years of Festival de Cannes archives, information about the organisation and practical services for accreditation and registration of films.

feeds.title: LUX Prize - The European Parliament
feeds.description: The European Parliament LUX prize casts an annual spotlight on films that go to the heart of the European public debate. The Parliament believes that the cinema, a mass cultural medium, can be an ideal vehicle for debate and reflection on Europe and its future. Cinema is popular, attracts different generations and is affordable.

feeds.title: British Film Institute - BFI Latest News
feeds.description: The BFI was founded in 1933. We are a charity governed by a Royal Charter. We combine cultural, creative and industrial roles, bringing together the BFI National Archive and BFI Reuben Library, film distribution, exhibition and education at BFI Southbank and BFI IMAX, publishing and festivals.

feeds.title: Britflicks - The home of british film
feeds.description: Britflicks, a site dedicated to supporting the British film industry. The latest British film news, releases, trailers, interviews and competitions.
